name: Learning from unlabeled data without labels
gist: Papers use contrastive learning and self-supervised methods to train models on large unlabeled datasets by predicting parts of the data from other parts, avoiding the need for expensive manual labels.
explain: The core insight is simple in concept but tricky in practice: if you have a piece of data, you can treat parts of it as a learning signal for other parts. Imagine a video — you hide one frame and train the model to predict it from the surrounding frames. Or an image where you mask out part of the picture and train the model to fill it in. These proxy tasks create a supervisory signal without any human having to label anything. The model learns to encode visual structure, temporal dynamics, or context because it needs those patterns to solve the reconstruction task.

The challenge is that proxy tasks can be gamed. A model could learn to predict masked pixels by memorizing local texture patterns without understanding objects or scenes. Researchers have discovered that contrastive methods work especially well: show the model two slightly different versions of the same image (by cropping, color shifting, rotating), and teach it that their representations should be similar, while random different images should be dissimilar. This forces the model to capture stable, semantic features rather than superficial details. But even this requires careful tuning — the temperature of the similarity comparison, the size of the batch, whether you use a memory buffer of past examples — all of these affect what the model learns.

Across the 115 papers in this subtheme, researchers explore variations: different proxy tasks (masking, contrastive, rotation prediction, clustering consistency), different architectures (CNNs, vision transformers — neural networks designed to process spatial images — and multimodal encoders), and different ways to combine tasks. Some papers ask whether you need pretraining at all versus just training on downstream tasks, or whether combining self-supervised pretraining with a small amount of labeled data beats either alone. The practical impact is large: models pretrained this way now outperform supervised learning on many benchmarks when downstream labels are scarce, because they have already discovered the foundational patterns in unlabeled data that don't require manual annotation.

papers.title: ATLAS: Adaptive Transfer Scaling Laws for Multilingual Pretraining, Finetuning, and Decoding the Curse of Multilinguality
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing scaling laws' generalization often by more than 0.3 R-squared and reveals computational crossover points for when to pretrain from scratch versus finetune from multilingual checkpoints.

papers.title: Animal behavioral analysis and neural encoding with transformer-based self-supervised pretraining
papers.contribution: Demonstrates improved performance on behavioral feature extraction, pose estimation, and action segmentation across multiple species.

papers.title: CSRv2: Unlocking Ultra-Sparse Embeddings
papers.contribution: CSRv2 reduces dead neurons from 80% to 20% and delivers 14% accuracy gain at k=2, achieving 7x speedup over Matryoshka Representation Learning and up to 300x improvements in compute and memory efficiency.

papers.title: ConRep4CO: Contrastive Representation Learning of Combinatorial Optimization Instances across Types
papers.contribution: ConRep4CO significantly improves representation quality and generalizability to problem scale across seven graph decision problems, with improvements of 61.27%, 32.20%, 36.46%, and 45.29% on optimization problems compared to baselines.

papers.title: Difficult Examples Hurt Unsupervised Contrastive Learning: A Theoretical Perspective
papers.contribution: Shows removing difficult examples can boost downstream classification performance despite reducing sample size, with theory and empirical validation.

papers.title: Geometric Constraints for Small Language Models to Understand and Expand Scientific Taxonomies
papers.contribution: Fine-tuned SLMs like DistilBERT-base (110M) consistently outperform frozen LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemma-2-9B) on both leaf and non-leaf taxonomy expansion, demonstrating lightweight yet effective structured knowledge enrichment.

papers.title: MULTIMODALITY AS SUPERVISION: SELF-SUPERVISED SPECIALIZATION TO THE TEST ENVIRONMENT VIA MULTIMODALITY
papers.contribution: Test-environment pretraining with multimodal data matches and often outperforms generalist models pretrained on large-scale internet datasets (CLIP, DINOv2) on semantic segmentation, captioning, and object detection tasks.

papers.title: MoRA: Mobility as the Backbone for Geospatial Representation Learning at Scale
papers.contribution: MoRA achieves superior predictive performance on 9 downstream prediction tasks by an average of 12.9% compared to state-of-the-art models and demonstrates scaling behavior in geospatial representation learning.

papers.title: Naming to Learn: Class Incremental Learning for Vision-Language Model with Unlabeled Data
papers.contribution: Achieves performance equivalent to joint training with unlabeled data, mitigating catastrophic forgetting and outperforming SOTA methods.

papers.title: PredNext: Explicit Cross-View Temporal Prediction for Unsupervised Learning in Spiking Neural Networks
papers.contribution: PredNext achieves performance comparable to ImageNet-pretrained supervised weights through unsupervised training on UCF101 and substantially improves temporal feature consistency across different tasks and methods.

papers.title: Rethinking JEPA: Compute‑Efficient Video Self-Supervised Learning with Frozen Teachers
papers.contribution: Outperforms V-JEPA 2 encoders on multiple benchmarks with better compute-efficiency; achieves higher probing accuracy at matched FLOPs with students robust to teacher quality.

papers.title: Stochastic Optimal Control for Continuous-Time fMRI Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on diverse downstream applications, unifying masked autoencoding and joint-embedding prediction while maintaining computational efficiency on large-scale fMRI datasets.

papers.title: TS-DDAE: A novel Temporal-Spectral Denoising Diffusion AutoEncoder for Wireless Signal Recognition Model Pre-training
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance on WSR tasks compared to SOTA baselines, demonstrating potential as a foundation model for wireless signal recognition.

papers.title: sleep2vec: Unified Cross-Modal Alignment for Heterogeneous Nocturnal Biosignals
papers.contribution: Outperforms baselines on sleep staging and clinical outcomes while remaining robust to any modality subset and sensor dropout; characterizes scaling laws for nocturnal biosignals.

papers.title: A Theory of Contrastive Learning with Natural Images
papers.contribution: Optimal weights form sinusoids whose frequencies can be computed via waterfilling algorithm; empirical CNNs trained with SGD learn these sinusoid patterns.

papers.title: AVEX: What Matters for Animal Vocalization Encoding
papers.contribution: Self-supervised pretraining followed by supervised post-training on mixed bioacoustics+general-audio yields state-of-the-art encoders across tasks.

papers.title: ArcDAE: Asymmetric Rectified Contrastive Diffusion Autoencoder for Unified Representation Learning
papers.contribution: ArcDAE surpasses state-of-the-art methods by up to 6.4% in downstream semantics regression and 9.7% in reconstruction fidelity on FFHQ-trained models.

papers.title: AudioMosaic: Contrastive Masked Audio Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on audio benchmarks with strong transferability across datasets and domains; enhances LLMs when integrated for audio perception.

papers.title: BAT: Better Audio Transformer Guided by Convex Gated Probing
papers.contribution: Better Audio Transformer (BAT) refined via CGP establishes new state-of-the-art on audio benchmarks through improved preprocessing, architecture, and pretraining recipe.

papers.title: Bayesian Gated Non-Negative Contrastive Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 142.1% improvement in semantic consistency compared to state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining downstream task performance.

papers.title: Beyond Buffer Limits: Energy-Based Data Reassembly for Continual Learning
papers.contribution: Data reassembly consistently outperforms existing memory-based approaches across continual learning benchmarks, achieving stronger retention while maintaining computational efficiency.

papers.title: Beyond Distribution Estimation: Simplex Anchored Structural Inference Towards Universal Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on five standard benchmarks with average accuracy gain of 8.52% by bypassing distribution estimation via structural consensus.

papers.title: Beyond Hearing: Learning Task-agnostic ExG Representations from Earphones via Physiology-informed Tokenization
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse tasks on a new HumanSense dataset and four public benchmarks.

papers.title: Bio-Inspired Self-Supervised Learning for Wrist-worn Accelerometer Data
papers.contribution: Representations pretrained on NHANES (~28k hours; ~11k participants) outperform self-supervised baselines across six subject-disjoint HAR benchmarks.

papers.title: Brep2Shape: Boundary and Shape Representation Alignment via Self-supervised Transformers
papers.contribution: To bridge this gap, we introduce Brep2Shape, a novel self-supervised pre-training framework designed to align abstract boundary representations with intuitive shape representations.

papers.title: CARL: Camera-Agnostic Representation Learning for Spectral Image Analysis
papers.contribution: Demonstrates robustness to spectral heterogeneity across medical, autonomous driving, and satellite imaging with publicly available code and weights.

papers.title: CLAP: Unsupervised 3D Representation Learning for Fusion 3D Perception via Curvature Sampling and Prototype Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 100% more performance gain than previous SOTA pre-training methods on NuScenes and Waymo datasets.

papers.title: Calibrated Information Bottleneck for Trusted Multi-modal Clustering
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive clustering accuracy with excellent expected calibration error performance through information redundancy-based label selection.

papers.title: Can local learning match self-supervised backpropagation?
papers.contribution: Best local-SSL with CLAPP loss matches comparable BP-SSL performance and improves state-of-the-art layer-wise SSL on multiple image datasets.

papers.title: Causal-JEPA: Learning World Models through Object-Level Latent Masking
papers.contribution: com/galilai-group/cjepa

papers.title: Collaborative Learning for Semi-Supervised LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
papers.contribution: CoLLiS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LiDAR SemiSL methods with particularly strong gains in low-label regimes by mitigating confirmation bias.

papers.title: Contrastive Order Learning: A General Framework for Ordinal Regression
papers.contribution: Consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on facial age estimation, blind image quality assessment, and blind video quality assessment with good generalization.

papers.title: Contrastive Symbolic Regression: Aligned Representations, Adaptive Prediction, and Diverse Ensembles
papers.contribution: Consistently surpasses both traditional symbolic regression and modern machine learning methods on 58 real-world regression datasets.

papers.title: Counterfactual Residual Data Augmentation for Regression
papers.contribution: Reduce MLP Regressor MSE by 22.9% and XGBoost Regressor MSE by 6.4% on average, outperforming existing data generators.

papers.title: Data Augmentation of Contrastive Learning is Estimating Positive-incentive Noise
papers.contribution: Successfully learns effective augmentations through the noise generator framework, providing theoretical grounding for data augmentation in contrastive learning.

papers.title: DeepFRC: An End-to-End Deep Learning Model for Functional Registration and Classification
papers.contribution: Provides first theoretical guarantees for joint registration-classification, proving ability to approximate optimal warpings and establishing data-dependent generalization bounds.

papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction with Point-distributions Similarity Invariant
papers.contribution: Theoretical feasibility is proven; benchmark and single-cell expression data demonstrate effectiveness and efficiency.

papers.title: Discretized Density-Guided Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Regression
papers.contribution: Demonstrates robust SFDA for regression under distribution shift with theoretical guarantees on perturbation resilience.

papers.title: Disentangling the Factors of Convergence between Brains and Computer Vision Models
papers.contribution: Shows all three factors independently and interactively impact brain similarity; largest models with human-centric images show highest alignment; development follows chronology (early→late cortex).

papers.title: Divergence-Free Neural Networks with Application to Image Denoising
papers.contribution: The divergence-free architecture retains sufficient expressivity to remain competitive while outperforming divergence-based approaches when noise level is unknown and varies.

papers.title: Diverse Dictionary Learning
papers.contribution: Intersections, complements, and symmetric differences of latent variables remain identifiable up to appropriate indeterminacies, enabling structured views of hidden world.

papers.title: Dual Perspectives on Non-Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning
papers.contribution: Proves in linear case that minimizing objective without stop gradient always leads to collapse; characterizes equilibria as asymptotically stable varieties.

papers.title: EMBridge: Enhancing Gesture Generalization from EMG Signals Through Cross-modal Representation Learning
papers.contribution: EMBridge achieves the first zero-shot gesture classification from wearable EMG signals with consistent performance gains on in-distribution and unseen gesture tasks.

papers.title: Emergent Visual Representations through Unsupervised Spiking Networks with Synaptic Pruning
papers.contribution: Without using labels, produces hierarchical visual representations strongly aligned with neural responses across multiple areas of mouse and macaque visual cortex, outperforming supervised and unsupervised ANN and SNN baselines.

papers.title: Enhancing Cross-subject Emotion Recognition via Heterogeneous Distribution Augmentation and Collaborative Learning
papers.contribution: Substantially improves cross-subject emotion recognition generalization through heterogeneous distribution augmentation and collaborative learning without requiring modality-specific designs.

papers.title: Equivariant Splitting: Self-supervised learning from incomplete data
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on image inpainting, accelerated MRI, sparse-view CT, and compressive sensing with highly rank-deficient models.

papers.title: FedHPro: Federated Hyper-Prototype Learning via Gradient Matching
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance under diverse heterogeneous scenarios with more semantically consistent global signals.

papers.title: GCIB: Graph Contrastive Information Bottleneck for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
papers.contribution: GCIB outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by learning noise-resilient and target-aware representations on multiple real-world datasets.

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Automatic Modulation Recognition
papers.contribution: Achieve 6.27% accuracy gain in 1-shot modulation recognition settings over prior methods.

papers.title: HOBIT: Hardness Optimized Batch Sampling for InfoNCE Training
papers.contribution: Incurs negligible overhead while significantly outperforming state-of-the-art batching methods with O(1-1/e) approximation guarantee.

papers.title: IdEst: Assessing Self-Supervised Learning Representations via Intrinsic Dimension
papers.contribution: Strongly correlates with linear probe performance while enabling efficient hyperparameter selection reducing computational cost.

papers.title: Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Classification via Shared Codebook and Fused-Teacher Self-Distillation
papers.contribution: The effectiveness of our proposed method is thoroughly demonstrated through extensive comparative experiments with advanced methods on five benchmark datasets

papers.title: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning of Latent Market States in U.S. Equities
papers.contribution: Learned embeddings are strongly associated with market volatility and correlation structure, weakly with direction; regime embeddings align with news-topic shifts without text supervision.

papers.title: LLM as an Algorithmist: Enhancing Anomaly Detectors via Programmatic Synthesis
papers.contribution: Consistently boosts mainstream detectors on 36 benchmarks by transforming problem into discriminative two-class classification via programmatic synthesis.

papers.title: Latent Particle World Models: Self-supervised Object-centric Stochastic Dynamics Modeling
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art results on diverse real-world and synthetic datasets while being applicable to goal-conditioned imitation learning.

papers.title: Learning Dynamics of Logits Debiasing for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.contribution: DyTrim consistently enhances existing LTSSL methods' performance by improving representation quality and prediction accuracy, implicitly realizing risk reweighting that effectively suppresses class bias.

papers.title: Learning Sparse Visual Representations via Spatial-Semantic Factorization
papers.contribution: As few as 16 sparse tokens achieve both high-quality reconstruction (2.60 FID) and strong semantic transfer (79.10% ImageNet accuracy).

papers.title: Learning the Neighborhood: Contrast-Free Multimodal Self-Supervised Molecular Graph Pretraining
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art results on MoleculeNet, surpassing contrastive and generative methods with effective transfer to new chemical domains.

papers.title: Let LLMs Speak Embedding Languages: Generative Text Embeddings via Iterative Contrastive Refinement
papers.contribution: Outperforms strong LLM-based embedding baselines on MTEB benchmarks and exhibits emergent test-time scaling where generating more tokens steadily improves embedding quality.

papers.title: MILCO: Learned Sparse Retrieval Across Languages via a Multilingual Connector
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art multilingual LSR performance while maintaining 3× lower retrieval latency and 10× smaller index size than dense alternatives.

papers.title: Maximizing Asynchronicity in Event-based Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Achieves 47.7 mAP on Gen1 detection, representing the first A2S framework to successfully master demanding event-based detection tasks.

papers.title: Maximizing Incremental Information Entropy for Contrastive Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently improves performance under small-batch settings on CIFAR-10/100, STL-10, and ImageNet with modules seamlessly integrable into existing frameworks.

papers.title: Midway Network: Learning Representations for Recognition and Motion from Latent Dynamics
papers.contribution: Learns strong representations for both semantic segmentation and optical flow on large-scale video datasets with novel forward feature perturbation analysis.

papers.title: Mobility-Embedded POIs: Learning What A Place Is and How It Is Used from Human Movement
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms text-only and mobility-only baselines on five map enrichment tasks; mobility alone surpasses text on certain tasks.

papers.title: Negatives-Dominant Contrastive Learning for Generalization in Imbalanced Domains
papers.contribution: NDCL demonstrates effectiveness on benchmarks while maintaining theoretical grounding through generalization bounds.

papers.title: NeuCLIP: Efficient Large-Scale CLIP Training with Neural Normalizer Optimization
papers.contribution: NeuCLIP achieves more accurate normalizer estimation on large-scale CLIP training spanning datasets from millions to billions of samples with improved performance.

papers.title: Neural Collapse by Design: Learning Class Prototypes on the Hypersphere
papers.contribution: We show that both paradigms are different appearances of the same method that contrasts prototypes on the unit hypersphere, and that closing the gap requires fixing each at its point of failure

papers.title: Newton-coupled Dual-Teacher Semi-supervised Learning Framework
papers.contribution: TTN consistently improves over single-teacher and consistency-based methods on ImageNet, CIFAR-10, SVHN, and STL-10.

papers.title: Noisy-Pair Robust Representation Alignment for Positive-Unlabeled Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves substantial improvements over state-of-the-art PU methods across diverse datasets, bridging the 14.26% gap on CIFAR-100, and demonstrates real-world application to post-disaster building damage mapping.

papers.title: On the Alignment Between Supervised and Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning
papers.contribution: Shows CL-NSCL alignment strengthens with scale and temperature; demonstrates parameter-space divergence grows exponentially but representation-space similarity remains stable.

papers.title: One-Shot Exemplars for Class Grounding in Self-Supervised Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 3% gain on CIFAR-100 and 6% on ImageNet-100 over state-of-the-art with negligible annotation cost.

papers.title: PATCHCODE: Discrete Latent Predictive Learning for EEG Foundation Model
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance across 16 downstream datasets with notable data-efficiency gains, offering robust EEG representations for emotion, motor imagery, sleep, and clinical tasks.

papers.title: PHALAR: Phasors for Learned Musical Audio Representations
papers.contribution: Achieves relative accuracy increase of ~70% over state-of-the-art with <50% parameters and 7x training speedup; correlates higher with human coherence judgment.

papers.title: Procedural Pretraining: Warming Up Language Models with Abstract Data
papers.contribution: Outperforms standard pretraining on C4, CodeParrot, and DeepMind-Math, enabling same loss with 55/67/86% of original training data.

papers.title: Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment Multimodal Federated Learning
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms sota baselines under model heterogeneity and modality imbalance conditions through joint handling of heterogeneous feature spaces and collective decision aggregation.

papers.title: Pseudo-Non-Linear Data Augmentation: A Constrained Energy Minimization Viewpoint
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive downstream performance while offering fine-grained controllability lacking in existing augmentation literature.

papers.title: Rectified LpJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures with Sparse and Maximum-Entropy Representations
papers.contribution: Learns sparse non-negative representations with favorable sparsity-performance tradeoffs and competitive downstream performance on image classification.

papers.contribution: Without annotated or synthetic query-document pairs, Revela surpasses larger supervised models on CoIR and BRIGHT benchmarks and achieves BEIR's unsupervised SoTA with 1000x less training data.

papers.title: Segment-driven Structural Induction and Semantic Alignment for Heterogeneous Tabular Representation
papers.contribution: Improves reconstruction, semantic consistency, and downstream utility on heterogeneous in-domain tables across evaluation settings.

papers.title: SigLIP-HD by Fine-to-Coarse Supervision

papers.title: Soft Equivariance Regularization for Invariant Self-Supervised Learning

papers.title: Unsupervised Representation Learning - an Invariant Risk Minimization Perspective
papers.contribution: Demonstrates effectiveness in capturing invariant structure, preserving information, and generalizing across environments without label supervision.
